title: Division 9 (Flooring) — Ranked Suite
description: Ranked (scoring + certification) suite for the Division 9 / flooring vertical. This is a SCAFFOLD: it intentionally ships with no task files and no ground truth. Answer keys are WITHHELD — established and held out by a licensed/expert estimator and never committed to this repo. Ranked tasks are populated only after that ground truth exists. The source plan assets live privately in the gitignored plans/ directory; at scoring time the held-out keys are materialized out-of-tree and read via the OTA_GROUNDTRUTH_DIR environment variable (see .github/workflows/score-submission.yml). Competencies mirror the Div-9 practice suite; per-competency pass thresholds are published per the protocol (PROTOCOL.md §3) per suite version. Do NOT add task files with answer keys or invented quantities — see this directory's README.md.
